superseded_candidate.reason: Raw read was bounded to 65536 bytes but lossy UTF8 followed by Debug escaping could expand the printed body beyond that bound. Root explicitly requested a separate final escaped-body bound.

details: Exactly the four existing timeout results receive lazily constructed error context; four original TEST_TIMEOUT arguments remain unchanged.
The constant resolves to 30 seconds in unchanged tests/common/relay.rs blob977b70d1ba423ab02d60305ab62d858d1658f05d.

The success/nonzero-exit oracle, stdout-only chunks, sequence tracking, 13MiB write/readback, frame-boundary check, encrypted relay assertion, connection close and forwarder/destination shutdown retain their original operations and ordering.
All original executable bytes are recovered by removing four clock declarations, four diagnostic contexts, the Context import and restoring equivalent await layout. No RPC is added or replayed.
Context only attributes outer timeout failures; an inner error remains its original failure. This diagnostic is not proof of the underlying timeout cause.
35 contextual annotations add only static source file/line and method names on existing error paths.
Expected release-denial, uninstalled-release-denial and invalid-drain .is_err() paths remain untouched.
Original 120s readiness, 15s daemon readiness, three 25ms polling sleeps, 73 await sites and all RPC call counts are unchanged.
The existing tokio::join! race, control fences, mutation acknowledgements, process identity checks, peer isolation and restart/rollback contracts are unchanged.
After removing the 35 annotations and added imports, and restoring the reviewed DaemonChild representation, the entire file is byte-identical to ff72.
The path is root.join("supervisord-child.log") where root is this test's canonical private TempDir. Both owned daemon children append stdout/stderr to exactly that existing file.
No shared process home, glob, user log or externally supplied arbitrary path is read.
The new struct merely retains the same Child plus the log path. Spawn argv/env/stdin/stdout/stderr and process count are unchanged.
try_wait/kill/wait behavior is the original implementation with self.0 renamed to self.child; Drop keeps its original kill then wait before reading diagnostics.
The test-owned append stream can contain both daemon generations and can be printed twice, once per Drop. Neither print is evidence belonging only to one PID.
Read errors are logged after cleanup and are not returned as a new test result. No control RPC is performed in Drop.
Open+metadata+seek to len.saturating_sub(65536), then take(65536).read_to_end preserves a maximum 65536 raw bytes.
Lossy UTF8 and Debug escaping occur exactly once. The resulting String is truncated to at most 65536 UTF8 bytes at a valid character boundary.
Final formatting uses Display contents={body}; it does not escape the body a second time.
Header separately records total bytes, source offset, raw_tail_bytes and body_truncated. Header metadata is outside the 65536-byte body cap.
No unsafe code or new external dependency is introduced. Format/style gates and actual platform execution remain pending.
